sampling: Fixed allocated episode IDs; every allocated episode completes without replacement by faster environments

motion_reference.selector: Measured peg bounding box, board height, opposed forces and grasp stability; no task phase

reset_distribution.translation_sampling: Uniform XY square centered on the same fixed source post; half-width in mm
reset_distribution.rotation_sampling: Uniform yaw about the peg hole center; bounds in degrees

handover_criterion: Measured opposed receiver contacts maintained for 2s with donor fingers free; virtual spring assistance remains explicitly active
low_level_control: Neural tool motors through generic IK/speed limits, plus explicit grasp spring and optional free-placement guide

upright_grasp_support.donor_acquisition: Measured opposed contact stable0.4s at bottom>9mm; before attempted lift

parameters.implementation_change: Preserve XYZ/rotation direction when bounding long pose commands
